journey.name: Selected language and reply audio on Android
journey.description: Verify the updated release uses the chosen voice language despite another input language and Android starts media speech playback.

actions.action: Verify version 1.2.3 build 2008 is installed and launches
Start Saarthi and verify generic accessibility automation does not turn audio off
Pause input and select Tamil in Voice options
Verify a Tamil written reply and started Android media/speech playback for this app
End the conversation and reopen it
Verify Tamil remains selected and End stops the conversation
